contacts.name: Contact Management
contacts.description: Full CRUD with CSV import and export. Interaction history, company association, customizable tags, and activity timeline. Up to unlimited contacts on the Business plan.

detail.headline: Centralize all your customer information in one place

1.title: Smart CSV import
1.text: Migrate from any CRM, spreadsheet, or ERP in minutes. Auto field mapping identifies columns and normalizes data — no manual work.

2.title: 360° interaction timeline
2.text: Every contact has a complete chronological timeline: WhatsApp messages, emails sent/received, team notes, activities, and stage changes.

3.title: Tags and advanced segmentation
3.text: Create unlimited tags with custom colors. Segment by buyer profile, funnel stage, campaign source, or any criteria that makes sense for your business.

4.title: Contact and company hierarchy
4.text: Link multiple contacts to a company. Define who is the decision-maker, influencer, and champion. View the deal's org chart directly on the contact card.

5.title: Combined search and filters
5.text: Find any contact in seconds. Combine filters by tag, assignee, creation date, company, pipeline, and custom fields. Save favorite filters for quick access.

6.title: Scale without limits
6.text: From 100 contacts on the free plan to unlimited on Business. As your team grows, Sirius grows with you — no platform migration needed.

1.scenario: Before a visit, checks the full client profile on mobile: last contact, open deal value, purchase history, and team notes.

2.scenario: Segments the base by tag 'Inactive > 60 days' and creates a reactivation email campaign with one click. Monitors opens and replies in analytics.

3.scenario: Imports 15,000 contacts from HubSpot via CSV. Sirius maps fields automatically, removes duplicates, and preserves interaction history.

1.title: Import or create
1.text: Upload your CSV or create contacts manually. Smart mapping recognizes name, email, phone, and custom fields automatically.

2.title: Enrich with AI
2.text: AGI Sirius automatically complements: job title, company, LinkedIn, segment, and relevant data for your approach. No copy-pasting.

3.title: Link to pipeline
3.text: Associate contacts with deals and companies for a 360° view of each opportunity. Every interaction feeds the timeline automatically.

4.title: Find in seconds
4.text: Use global search with combined filters. Save favorite filters. Export segments for email or WhatsApp campaigns.

detail.planInfo: Free: up to 100 contacts | Starter: 2,500 | Pro: 15,000 | Business: unlimited

1.q: Can I import contacts from another CRM?
1.a: Yes. Sirius accepts CSV with automatic field mapping. Works with exports from HubSpot, Pipedrive, RD Station, Salesforce, and any spreadsheet.

2.q: Are contacts shared with the team?
2.a: Yes. All organization members see contacts. On Business plan, you can restrict visibility per pipeline.

3.a: Yes. On the Business plan, we integrate via Meta Official WhatsApp Business API. Conversations appear automatically on the contact timeline and you reply directly from the CRM — no ban risk.

deals.name: Deals
deals.description: Track value, closing date, assignee, and stage. Linked notes, activities, and comments. Drag-and-drop in Kanban. Data export.

detail.headline: Track every sales opportunity from first contact to close

1.title: Visual Kanban with drag-and-drop
1.text: Drag deals between stages with a gesture. Visualize the entire funnel in columns with accumulated value, count, and closing forecast per stage.

2.title: Complete card information
2.text: Each card shows value, expected date, assignee, close probability, and deal temperature. No need to open the detail view.

3.title: Complete interaction history
3.text: Notes, activities, comments, and WhatsApp messages linked to the deal in a chronological timeline. The entire team sees the full context.

4.title: Unlimited custom fields
4.text: Adapt the deal to your business model. Create text, number, date, select, and checkbox fields. Configure which fields appear on the Kanban card.

5.title: Powerful filters and saved views
5.text: Filter by assignee, pipeline, stage, min/max value, and period. Save filter combinations as views for quick access.

6.title: Export and reports
6.text: Export filtered deals to CSV. Generate revenue forecast, pipeline velocity, and conversion rate reports by stage.

1.scenario: Sorts the Kanban by value and probability to focus on deals most likely to close this week. Adds notes after each call.

2.scenario: Opens the consolidated pipeline view: $460K open, 47 active deals, 12 stale for over 7 days. Identifies bottlenecks instantly.

3.scenario: Creates the deal after qualifying the lead, logs all interactions, and moves to 'Qualified' — the closer gets an automatic notification with full context.

1.title: Create the deal
1.text: Manually in 3 clicks or automatically via automation when a lead arrives. Set value, assignee, and initial stage.

2.title: Drag in Kanban
2.text: As the deal progresses, drag between stages. Each change is logged in the timeline with date, time, and who moved it.

3.title: Log everything
3.text: Add notes after calls, schedule follow-ups as tasks, send WhatsApp messages — everything stays in the deal history.

4.title: Close or learn
4.text: Mark as Won and celebrate. Or mark as Lost with a reason — AI analyzes loss patterns and suggests process improvements.

detail.planInfo: Free: up to 50 active deals | Starter: 500 | Pro: 5,000 | Business: unlimited

1.q: Can I have deals in multiple pipelines?
1.a: Yes. Each deal belongs to one pipeline, but you can move it between pipelines at any time. Ideal for transfers between teams.

2.q: Do archived deals count toward the limit?
2.a: No. Only active (open) deals count. Won, lost, or archived deals don't affect your limit.

3.a: Yes. Analytics shows revenue forecast based on value x probability x estimated closing date for each open deal.

pipelines.name: Multiple Pipelines
pipelines.description: Create separate pipelines by product, region, or team. Configure custom stages, set a default pipeline, and link specific automations per pipeline.

detail.headline: Organize your sales processes with independent pipelines

1.title: Independent pipelines
1.text: Each pipeline is a complete funnel. Separate by product, service, region, or team. Each with its own stages, automations, and metrics.

2.title: 100% customizable stages
2.text: Define names, colors, and order for stages. Drag to reorder. Set default close probability per stage.

3.title: Smart default pipeline
3.text: Define which pipeline receives new deals automatically. Perfect for teams with one main funnel and specialized funnels.

4.title: Per-pipeline automations
4.text: Each pipeline can have its own rules: send email on 'Proposal', create task on 'Negotiation', alert manager on 'Closing'.

5.title: Consolidated and individual views
5.text: Dashboard shows metrics for all pipelines together or filtered by one. Compare performance across funnels.

6.title: Granular permissions
6.text: On Business plan, restrict which salespeople see which pipelines. Ideal for teams with confidential or regional processes.

1.scenario: Enterprise pipeline with 8 stages and long cycle. Self-service pipeline with 3 stages and short cycle. Separate metrics, same team.

2.scenario: Pipelines by region: East, West, Central, South. Each regional manager sees only their pipeline. Director sees all consolidated.

3.scenario: Recurring contracts pipeline for monthly fees. Projects pipeline for one-off jobs. Different automations for each sales flow.

1.title: Create the pipeline
1.text: In Settings > Pipelines, give it a name and description. Choose if it's the default pipeline for new deals.

2.title: Configure stages
2.text: Add stages with name and color. Drag to reorder. Set default close probability for each stage.

3.title: Link automations
3.text: For each stage, create triggers: send email, create task, notify team. Each pipeline can have totally different rules.

4.title: Assign and track
4.text: New deals enter the default pipeline automatically. Move between pipelines when needed. Track each funnel's metrics separately.

detail.planInfo: Free: 1 pipeline | Starter: 3 | Pro: 10 | Business: unlimited

1.q: Can I move a deal from one pipeline to another?
1.a: Yes, at any time. History is preserved and the change is logged in the deal timeline.

2.q: Do automations from one pipeline affect another?
2.a: No. Each pipeline has its own automations. A rule created in the 'Enterprise' pipeline won't fire in 'Self-service'.

3.q: Can I compare performance across pipelines?
3.a: Yes. Analytics shows win rate, average cycle, total value, and velocity per pipeline. Ideal for identifying your best-performing funnel.

tasks.name: Activities & Tasks
tasks.description: Create tasks linked to deals and contacts. Set assignees, deadlines, and reminders. Automatically sync with Google Calendar.

detail.headline: Never miss a follow-up — tasks and reminders integrated into the CRM

1.title: Tasks with full context
1.text: Each task is linked to the deal or contact. When you open it, you see the full interaction history, deal value, and last message — no navigation needed.

2.title: Multi-channel reminders
2.text: Get reminders via mobile push notification, email, and browser notification. Configure how far in advance you want to be notified.

3.title: Bidirectional Google Calendar sync
3.text: Tasks created in Sirius appear in your Google Calendar. Events created in Google Calendar appear in Sirius's agenda. Edit anywhere.

4.title: Specialized activity types
4.text: Call, in-person meeting, video conference, email, field visit, follow-up. Each type has its own icon and color for quick identification.

5.title: Dashboard-integrated agenda
5.text: Daily and weekly view of the entire team's tasks. Drag to reschedule. Filter by assignee, type, or deal. Identify overloaded days.

6.title: Assignment and delegation
6.text: Assign tasks to any team member. The assignee gets an instant notification with deal context. Ideal for managers delegating follow-ups.

1.scenario: After each Zoom meeting, creates a follow-up task for 3 days later. Gets push and email reminders. Never forgets to resume the conversation.

2.scenario: Opens the team's weekly agenda: 42 tasks across 5 reps. Sees John has 15 and Ana has 3. Redistributes by dragging tasks between assignees.

3.scenario: Schedules visits on Google Calendar from mobile. Visits auto-appear in Sirius linked to the deal. Checks in with GPS on arrival.

1.title: Create the task
1.text: Directly from the deal or contact card. Choose type (call, meeting, follow-up), set deadline, and assign. 3 clicks.

2.title: Get reminders
2.text: Push notification + email before deadline. Configure 15 min, 1 hour, 1 day, or custom advance interval.

3.title: See in your agenda
3.text: The task appears in Sirius's agenda AND Google Calendar. Edit anywhere — sync is bidirectional and automatic.

4.title: Complete and log
4.text: Mark as done, add a note about the outcome, and Sirius logs everything in the deal timeline. Manager sees it in the report.

detail.planInfo: Available on all plans | Google Calendar: from Starter onwards

1.q: Do I need Google Calendar to use tasks?
1.a: No. Tasks work independently. Google Calendar is an optional integration that enables bidirectional sync (available from Starter).

2.a: Yes. Set frequency (daily, weekly, monthly) and Sirius automatically creates the next task when the current one is completed.

3.q: Do tasks count toward any limit?
3.a: No. Tasks are unlimited on all plans. Create as many as you need without worrying.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy is fundamental to us. This policy explains how we collect, use and protect your data.

s1.title: 1. Information We Collect
s1.usageText: Pages visited, features used, session duration.
s1.crmText: Contacts, deals, pipelines and other information you enter into the system.
s1.paymentText: Processed exclusively by Mercado Pago. We do not store credit card data.

s2.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
s2.provideText: Manage your account, process payments, send notifications.
s2.improveText: Analyze aggregate usage to identify improvements and bugs.
s2.communicateText: Send transactional emails (account confirmation, invoices) and marketing (with opt-out).
s2.securityText: Detect and prevent fraud, abuse and attacks.
s2.neverSell: We never sell your data to third parties.

s3.title: 3. Data Isolation (Multi-Tenant)
s3.p1: Each organization's data is completely isolated. Users of {orgA} can never view or access data from {orgB}.
s3.p2: All database queries include a filter by {field} to ensure absolute isolation.

s4.title: 4. Security Measures
s4.encryptionText: Passwords with bcrypt, data in transit via HTTPS/TLS.
s4.authText: JWT tokens with expiration, HttpOnly and SameSite cookies.
s4.dbText: PostgreSQL hosted on secure servers with daily backups.
s4.monitoringText: Access logs and error monitoring via Sentry.

s5.title: 5. Cookies and Tracking
s5.essentialText: Required for authentication and system operation.
s5.analyticsText: We use GA4 for aggregated usage analysis (anonymized).
s5.optOut: You can disable non-essential cookies in your browser settings.

s6.title: 6. Data Sharing
s6.dpa: All partners sign DPAs (Data Processing Agreements) in compliance with LGPD.

s7.title: 7. Your Rights (LGPD)
s7.intro: Under the General Data Protection Law (LGPD), you have the right to:
s7.accessText: Request a copy of all your data.
s7.deletionText: Delete your account and all associated data.
s7.portabilityText: Export your data in a readable format.
s7.revocationText: Withdraw consent for marketing at any time.
s7.contact: To exercise your rights, send an email to:

s8.title: 8. Data Retention
s8.activeText: We retain your data while your account is active.
s8.afterCancelText: Data is retained for 90 days for recovery, then permanently deleted.
s8.logsText: Retained for 1 year for security purposes.

s9.title: 9. Changes to This Policy
s9.p1: We may update this policy periodically. Significant changes will be communicated by email with 30 days' notice.
s9.p2: We recommend reviewing this page regularly.

cta.title: Questions about privacy?
cta.subtitle: Our team is available to clarify any questions about how we handle your data.
